inputs.question: How large are the creature, spell, house, world and town lists?
inputs.answer: Not stated in the repository; loaded at startup from an external mapping asset.

completeness.repository_coverage: Name-lookup and validation paths read in full; HTML parsers only sampled for case-folding calls.

unknowns.subject: Actual size of the validation lists and per-request CPU/memory
unknowns.what_would_resolve_it: Go benchmark of IsCreatureNameValid and IsSpellNameOrFormulaValid with the production list, plus a pprof CPU/alloc profile of a staging endpoint.

unknowns.subject: Upstream fetch and HTML parsing cost per request
unknowns.what_would_resolve_it: A profile or trace of a representative request in staging.

known: Case-insensitive lookups use strings.EqualFold against slices loaded once in Initiate (src/validation/tibia.go, src/validation/validation.go).
No per-request ToLower is applied to the lists in the lookup functions.
unknown: Number of creatures, spells, houses, worlds and towns.

decision_changing_questions.question: Is there a profile or trace showing the slow case-insensitive requests, and which endpoint do they hit?
decision_changing_questions.what_it_would_change: Would show whether the cost is in validation or elsewhere (upstream fetch, HTML parsing), which this review could not see.

considered_not_reported.observation: Linear scan with strings.EqualFold (up to three comparisons per entry) over the creature and spell lists in IsCreatureNameValid and IsSpellNameOrFormulaValid.
considered_not_reported.why_discarded: EqualFold folds in place without allocating, the lists are static and in memory, name length is bounded by validation before the scan, and the scan precedes a network fetch that dominates request cost. No mechanism produces the reported excess memory.
considered_not_reported.revisit_when: A benchmark or profile shows the scan in the top CPU samples, or the lists grow by orders of magnitude.

considered_not_reported.observation: GetHouseRaw and GetHouseInTown linearly scan the houses slice, copying a small struct per iteration, with EqualFold on town.
considered_not_reported.why_discarded: Bounded in-memory list, called once per house request, no allocation per iteration.
considered_not_reported.revisit_when: A profile shows house lookup as a hotspot.
